question_text: A toy car shown in figure (a) having an isolated metal axle $PQ$ travels with a constant speed $v$ along a sinusoidal path whose vertical cross-section is in the $x$-$z$ plane. The origin $O$ is at $z = 0$. The axle $PQ$ coincides with the $y$ axis. If a uniform magnetic field of flux density $\mathbf{B}$ exists throughout the region in the direction of the positive $z$ axis, then the variation of the induced emf ($e$) at the end $P$ of the axle with respect to end $Q$ with time ($t$) is best represented by. (Neglect the effect of the Earth magnetic field.)
